Call for Papers

We'd love to hear from you! Submit your talk proposal below. After having problems with our SaaS provider for handling the talk submissions, we have rolled our own so we don't slow down the process.

We are looking for speakers with a story to share, whether you consider yourself an expert, or someone taking their first steps. We want to appeal to a broad range of experience. We also want to cover real life case studies, understanding what went well and what did not. We are interested in the use of tech for good. We are also keen to focus on talks that cover the use of generative and agentic AI, machine learning, cloud security, sovereign cloud and even containers. As a tech event in South Wales, we are always keen to here from speakers or organisations that have a footprint in this area.
